title: Sleep story - The Night Train North

parts.style: warm, gentle late-night welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Good evening. <short pause> Tonight's story is called The Night Train North. <short pause> Before we begin, let your body settle... <short pause> and let your shoulders drop away from your ears.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Take a slow breath in... <short pause> and let it all the way out. <short pause> You don't need to follow every word. <short pause> Just let the story move along beside you, like the view from a window.

parts.style: tender, quiet storytelling
parts.text: The station is old and made of red brick, with a tall clock that ticks loudly in the evening air. <short pause> Snow has been falling since the afternoon, small and soft, and it gathers on the edges of the platform like sugar. <short pause> A woman named Clara stands under the lamplight with a small suitcase and a ticket in her gloved hand.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: The train comes in slowly, with a long, low sigh of steam. <short pause> It is painted deep green, with gold letters on the side, and its windows glow a warm yellow. <short pause> A conductor with a kind face and a gray mustache steps down and takes her ticket. <short pause> Car number four, he says. <short pause> The last cabin on the left.

parts.style: tender, quiet storytelling
parts.text: The cabin is small, and perfect. <short pause> There is a narrow bed made up with crisp white sheets and a thick wool blanket the color of oatmeal. <short pause> There is a little folding table by the window, and a brass reading lamp with a green glass shade. <short pause> Clara hangs up her coat, sits down on the edge of the bed, and lets out a long breath.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: With a gentle jolt, the train begins to move. <short pause> The platform slides away. <short pause> The station lights grow smaller. <short pause> And then the town is behind them, and there is only the dark, and the snow, and the steady sound of the wheels on the rails.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Clickety-clack. <short pause> Clickety-clack. <short pause> Clickety-clack.

parts.style: tender, quiet storytelling
parts.text: There is a soft knock at the door. <short pause> It is the conductor again, with a small tray. <short pause> A pot of chamomile tea, a cup and saucer, and two shortbread biscuits wrapped in paper. <short pause> For the journey, he says, and closes the door quietly behind him.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Clara pours the tea and holds the warm cup in both hands. <short pause> Outside the window, the world is blue and white. <short pause> Snowy fields stretch away in every direction, smooth and untouched. <short pause> Now and then a farmhouse passes by, with one window lit, and smoke rising slowly from the chimney.

parts.style: tender, quiet storytelling
parts.text: The train climbs gently into the hills. <short pause> Pine trees appear, tall and dark, their branches heavy with snow. <short pause> The moon comes out from behind a cloud, and suddenly everything shines silver. <short pause> Clara turns off the reading lamp so she can see it better.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: They pass a frozen lake, perfectly still, with the moon reflected in the middle of it like a coin. <short pause> They cross a small stone bridge over a river that has not quite frozen, its dark water moving slowly under a lace of ice. <short pause> They pass a village where every roof is white, and a church bell rings once, faint and far away.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Clickety-clack. <short pause> Clickety-clack. <short pause> The rhythm never changes. <short pause> It is slow and steady, like a heartbeat, like breathing.

parts.style: tender, quiet storytelling
parts.text: Somewhere in the night, the train stops at a tiny station in the middle of the forest. <short pause> There is no one on the platform, just a single lantern and a wooden bench covered in snow. <short pause> The train waits there for a minute, humming softly. <short pause> Then, with another gentle sigh, it moves on.

parts.style: soft, heartfelt, slower
parts.text: Clara finishes her tea and sets the cup down on the little table. <short pause> She slips under the wool blanket. <short pause> The sheets are cool at first, and then warm. <short pause> The pillow is soft and smells faintly of lavender. <short pause> The train rocks her gently, from side to side, the way a boat rocks on calm water.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: She thinks about where she is going, and then she lets the thought go. <short pause> There is nothing to do until morning. <short pause> No one needs anything from her. <short pause> The train knows the way. <short pause> All she has to do is rest.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: And perhaps that is true for you tonight, too. <short pause> The day is behind you, like the station lights. <short pause> Tomorrow is still far down the track. <short pause> Right now, there is only this quiet, steady journey through the dark, and the warmth around you.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: Outside, the snow keeps falling, soft and slow. <short pause> The moon follows the train across the sky. <short pause> The pine trees pass by, one after another, after another. <short pause> And the cabin is warm, and dim, and still.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Clickety-clack. <short pause> Clickety-clack. <short pause> Clickety... <short pause> clack.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Let your breath slow down to match the rhythm. <short pause> Breathe in... <short pause> and breathe out. <short pause> Let your body grow heavy, sinking into the bed, the way Clara sinks into hers. <short pause> There is nowhere you need to be.

parts.style: soft, near-whispered, soothing goodnight
parts.text: The train is carrying you north, through the snow, through the night. <short pause> You don't need to stay awake for any of it. <short pause> When you open your eyes, it will be morning. <short pause> Rest now. <short pause> Goodnight.
